description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetAutoloadFilters, which extends another class to provide functionality for retrieving autoload filters in Smarty template engine. It includes a method getAutoloadFilters that returns the autoload filters based on type.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetAutoloadFilters
classes.description: Provides functionality to retrieve autoload filters in Smarty, extending Smarty_Internal_Method_SetAutoloadFilters.

methods.name: getAutoloadFilters
methods.description: Retrieves autoload filter(s) based on specified type, returning an array of filters.
